Bisa cek struktur project bot ini dan rangkum dalam 3 poin singkat

Berikut adalah ringkasan struktur project bot WhatsApp ini dalam 3 poin singkat:

1. **Engine & Konfigurasi Utama (ESM)**
   * Dibangun menggunakan Node.js (ES Modules) berbasis library [`@whiskeysockets/baileys`](file:///home/runner/workspace/package.json).
   * Titik masuk aplikasi dan lifecycle diatur di [index.js](file:///home/runner/workspace/index.js), sedangkan pengaturan bot, owner, dan pesan sistem berada di [settings.js](file:///home/runner/workspace/settings.js).

2. **Arsitektur Plugin & Core Library**
   * **Sistem Perintah Modular**: Menggunakan plugin loader dinamis di folder [plugins/](file:///home/runner/workspace/plugins) yang terorganisir per kategori (`ai`, `downloader`, `group`, `main`, `owner`, `sticker`, `tools`, `antigravity`).
   * **Core & Helper**: Penanganan koneksi, serialisasi pesan, dan event handler diatur dalam [lib/connection.js](file:///home/runner/workspace/lib/connection.js), [lib/handler.js](file:///home/runner/workspace/lib/handler.js), serta [lib/serialize.js](file:///home/runner/workspace/lib/serialize.js) dengan berbagai fungsi pembantu di [utils/](file:///home/runner/workspace/utils).

3. **Penyimpanan Data & Manajemen Sesi**
   * **Database JSON**: Mengelola data pengguna, grup, dan konfigurasi secara lokal via [database/index.js](file:///home/runner/workspace/database/index.js) dan [database/db.json](file:///home/runner/workspace/database/db.json).
   * **Sesi WhatsApp**: Kredensial autentikasi multi-device dan pairing code tersimpan di direktori `sessions/`.

### 🔍 Detail Komponen Utama

#### 1. Entry Point & Konfigurasi
* **[`index.js`](file:///home/runner/workspace/index.js)**: Memuat konfigurasi, menginisialisasi database, me-load seluruh plugin secara asinkron, menghubungkan socket WhatsApp, serta menangani *graceful shutdown* dan *uncaught error handling*.
* **[`settings.js`](file:///home/runner/workspace/settings.js)**: Pusat konfigurasi bot (nomor owner, metode login pairing/QR, prefix, batas limit gratis/premium, auto-read, auto-react status, dan template respon).
* **[`package.json`](file:///home/runner/workspace/package.json)**: Menggunakan standard **ES Modules (`"type": "module"`)** dengan dependensi utama `@whiskeysockets/baileys`, `pino`, `chalk`, `jimp`, `fluent-ffmpeg`, dan `axios`.

---

#### 2. Core Engine ([`lib/`](file:///home/runner/workspace/lib))
* **[`lib/connection.js`](file:///home/runner/workspace/lib/connection.js)**: Mengatur *lifecycle* koneksi Baileys, auto-reconnect, pembuatan pairing code 8-digit ke terminal, pembaruan kredensial, dan auto-clear file session sampah berkala.
* **[`lib/handler.js`](file:///home/runner/workspace/lib/handler.js)**: Mesin utama *command router*:
  * **Dynamic Hot-Reloading**: Memuat file plugin secara otomatis saat bot berjalan tanpa perlu restart.
  * **Syntax Guard**: Memeriksa sintaks JavaScript sebelum di-import agar bot tidak *crash* jika terjadi error kode.
  * **Permission Checks**: Validasi otomatis untuk `ownerOnly`, `groupOnly`, `privateOnly`, `adminOnly`, `botAdminOnly`, `limit`, dan `cooldown`.
* **[`lib/serialize.js`](file:///home/runner/workspace/lib/serialize.js)**: Memperkaya objek pesan (`m`) dan socket (`sock`) dengan helper seperti `m.reply()`, `m.react()`, `m.download()`, serta mendeteksi tipe pesan terenkripsi.
* **[`lib/antigravity.js`](file:///home/runner/workspace/lib/antigravity.js)**: Integrasi khusus ke API Google Antigravity dengan manajemen token, multi-turn conversation memory, dan vision analysis.

---

#### 3. Modul Plugin ([`plugins/`](file:///home/runner/workspace/plugins))
Setiap file plugin hanya menangani satu perintah atau grup fitur terkait:
* **`main/`** ([`menu.js`](file:///home/runner/workspace/plugins/main/menu.js), [`ping.js`](file:///home/runner/workspace/plugins/main/ping.js), [`speed.js`](file:///home/runner/workspace/plugins/main/speed.js), [`profile.js`](file:///home/runner/workspace/plugins/main/profile.js), [`owner.js`](file:///home/runner/workspace/plugins/main/owner.js))
* **`antigravity/`** ([`agychat.js`](file:///home/runner/workspace/plugins/antigravity/agychat.js), [`vision.js`](file:///home/runner/workspace/plugins/antigravity/vision.js), [`model.js`](file:///home/runner/workspace/plugins/antigravity/model.js), [`login.js`](file:///home/runner/workspace/plugins/antigravity/login.js), [`token.js`](file:///home/runner/workspace/plugins/antigravity/token.js), dll)
* **`group/`** ([`hidetag.js`](file:///home/runner/workspace/plugins/group/hidetag.js), [`tagall.js`](file:///home/runner/workspace/plugins/group/tagall.js), [`kick.js`](file:///home/runner/workspace/plugins/group/kick.js), [`promote.js`](file:///home/runner/workspace/plugins/group/promote.js), [`demote.js`](file:///home/runner/workspace/plugins/group/demote.js), [`link.js`](file:///home/runner/workspace/plugins/group/link.js))
* **`downloader/`** ([`tiktok.js`](file:///home/runner/workspace/plugins/downloader/tiktok.js), [`youtube.js`](file:///home/runner/workspace/plugins/downloader/youtube.js))
* **`sticker/`** ([`sticker.js`](file:///home/runner/workspace/plugins/sticker/sticker.js), [`toimg.js`](file:///home/runner/workspace/plugins/sticker/toimg.js))
* **`tools/`** ([`translate.js`](file:///home/runner/workspace/plugins/tools/translate.js), [`qr.js`](file:///home/runner/workspace/plugins/tools/qr.js), [`inspect.js`](file:///home/runner/workspace/plugins/tools/inspect.js), [`quoted.js`](file:///home/runner/workspace/plugins/tools/quoted.js))
* **`owner/`** ([`eval.js`](file:///home/runner/workspace/plugins/owner/eval.js), [`exec.js`](file:///home/runner/workspace/plugins/owner/exec.js), [`addprem.js`](file:///home/runner/workspace/plugins/owner/addprem.js), [`setlimit.js`](file:///home/runner/workspace/plugins/owner/setlimit.js), [`clearsession.js`](file:///home/runner/workspace/plugins/owner/clearsession.js), [`autoreactsw.js`](file:///home/runner/workspace/plugins/owner/autoreactsw.js), dll)

---

#### 4. Database & Utilitas ([`database/`](file:///home/runner/workspace/database) & [`utils/`](file:///home/runner/workspace/utils))
* **[`database/index.js`](file:///home/runner/workspace/database/index.js)**: Menyediakan *in-memory cache* dengan sinkronisasi debounced ke [`database/db.json`](file:///home/runner/workspace/database/db.json).
* **[`utils/font.js`](file:///home/runner/workspace/utils/font.js)**: Merender tampilan teks estetik dengan *small-caps converter* dan dekorasi glyph modern.
* **[`utils/cleaner.js`](file:///home/runner/workspace/utils/cleaner.js)**: Menjaga ukuran folder [`sessions/`](file:///home/runner/workspace/sessions) agar tidak membengkak karena file pre-key lama.
